Name: (FS) Some Cute Hairs Revamped
Author: FaerieFangs0
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds 7 cute, simple hairs to Fashion Sense for those of us who like to dress up our farmers. Revamped with an extra hair and lightened up to match any color your heart desires a bit better.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Use your preferred mod manager, or drag and drop the folder into Mods manually. You probably know how FS hair mods work! You probably have a billion of them installed. I do, too. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Adds some jirai kei looking tails, buns, two long hairs, a spikey pony, drill tails, and long tails.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fashion sense and it's dependencies.[/color][/size]
